description: Update fields on ONE tag (PATCH — only fields you supply are changed). Editable fields: name, color, match (matching pattern), matching_algorithm, is_insensitive, parent (parent tag ID for hierarchy). To add or remove this tag on documents, use edit_documents_bulk with method 'add_tag' / 'remove_tag' / 'modify_tags' instead.

matching_algorithm.description: Matching algorithm: 0=None, 1=Any word, 2=All words, 3=Exact match, 4=Regular expression, 5=Fuzzy word, 6=Automatic

parent.description: Parent tag ID for hierarchical tags

name: update_tag
